records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first project reached [email:6d5eb15d], one invite sent, customer replied warmly and is receptive [email:8d738dc6], 8 days left. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6, they no-showed the onboarding call [calendar:8ba1d176], and the walkthrough was deferred to "at some point" — suggesting low urgency.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Silver Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Glad the first week has gone smoothly, and good to hear another person is in there with you. Whenever that walkthrough would be useful, I'm happy to set one up.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through getting your team's work organized in Wrenfield, where projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and answer anything that's come up so far. If a call isn't convenient, just reply here and I'll help with whatever next step is most useful.

Best,
Chidi
